arxiv-2103-04159.title: The gradient descent method for the convexification to solve boundary value problems of quasi-linear PDEs and a coefficient inverse problem
arxiv-2103-04159.creator: Thuy T. Le, Loc H. Nguyen
arxiv-2103-04159.description: Abstract We study the global convergence of the gradient descent method of the minimization of strictly convex functionals on an open and bounded set of a Hilbert space. Such results are unknown for this type of sets, unlike the case of the entire Hilbert space.

arxiv-2109-01240.title: Entrainment into particle-laden turbulent plumes
arxiv-2109-01240.creator: Craig D. McConnochie, Claudia Cenedese, Jim N. McElwaine
arxiv-2109-01240.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Craig D. McConnochie, Claudia Cenedese, Jim N. McElwaine. We use laboratory experiments to investigate the entrainment of ambient fluid into an axisymmetric turbulent plume containing dense particles with a settling velocity that is considerably smaller than the plume velocity. We consider the effect of particle size, particle concentration, and the orientation of the plume buoyancy flux – either in the same or opposite direction to the particle buoyancy flux.

arxiv-2308-02105.title: Analytical Phase Reduction for Weakly Nonlinear Oscillators
arxiv-2308-02105.creator: Iván León, Hiroya Nakao
arxiv-2308-02105.description: Abstract Phase reduction is a dimensionality reduction scheme to describe the dynamics of nonlinear oscillators with a single phase variable. While it is crucial in synchronization analysis of coupled oscillators, analytical results are limited to few systems. In this work, we analytically perform phase reduction for a wide class of oscillators by extending the Poincaré-Lindstedt perturbation theory.

arxiv-2405-17398.creator: Shenyuan Gao, Jiazhi Yang, Li Chen, Kashyap Chitta, Yihang Qiu, Andreas Geiger, Jun Zhang, Hongyang Li
arxiv-2405-17398.description: Abstract World models can foresee the outcomes of different actions, which is of paramount importance for autonomous driving. Nevertheless, existing driving world models still have limitations in generalization to unseen environments, prediction fidelity of critical details, and action controllability for flexible application. In this paper, we present Vista , a generalizable driving world model with high fidelity and versatile controllability.

arxiv-2505-10620.description: Abstract SS 433, located at the center of the W 50 radio nebula, is a binary system that ejects jets oriented east-west with precessional motion. arxiv-2505-17294.title: Promoted current-induced spin polarization in inversion symmetry broken topological insulator thin films
arxiv-2505-17294.creator: Maryam Heydari, Hanieh Moghaddasi, Mir Vahid Hosseini, Mehdi Askari
arxiv-2505-17294.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Maryam Heydari, Hanieh Moghaddasi, Mir Vahid Hosseini, Mehdi Askari. We theoretically investigate current-induced spin polarization in disordered topological insulator thin films with broken inversion symmetry under an applied in-plane electric field. Utilizing the Kubo formalism within the self-consistent Born approximation and incorporating vertex corrections to account for multiple scattering events, we analyze how disorder, chemical potential, the electrostatic potential difference between the top and bottom surfaces, and momentum-dependent hybridization affect the spin susceptibility.

pmc-12796900.title: 妊娠期高血压孕妇孕晚期血小板活化因子、Fibulin-3及脐动脉血流变化与新生儿结局的关系
pmc-12796900.creator: 应妹 孙, 红丽 张, 莉 孙
pmc-12796900.description: 目的 分析妊娠期高血压（gestational hypertension, GH）孕妇孕晚期血小板活化因子（platelet-activating factor, PAF）、Fibulin-3及脐动脉血流变化与新生儿结局的关系。方法收集2020年1月–2024年12月期间在我院进行规律产检及分娩的420例GH孕产妇的资料，按新生儿结局分为良好结局组（n=319）和不良结局组（n=101）。采用单因素及多因素logistic回归法分析不良新生儿结局的危险因素，基于危险因素分析结果构建预测模型，采用受试者工作特征（receiver operating characteristic, ROC）曲线及Hosmer-Lemeshow检验评价模型的区分能力、校准能力。结果 不良结局组与良好结局组的年龄、孕前体质量指数、重度妊娠期高血压、PAF、Fibulin-3、脐动脉血流〔收缩期血流峰速与舒张末期最大血流速比值（peak systolicvelocity/end diastolic veloci, S/D）、搏动指数（pulsatilityindex, PI）、阻力指数（resistanceindex, RI）〕差异有统计学意义（P<0.05）。多因素logistic回归分析显示血清PAF升高、Fibulin-3降低及脐动脉S/D、PI、RI增加均是GH孕妇发生不良新生儿结局的独立危险因素（P<0.05）。基于多因素分析结果构建预测模型，模型公式为Logit（P）=1.364×S/D+4.199×PI+5.303×RI+0.534×PAF（μg/L）－0.229×Fibulin-3（ng/mL）－7.996。ROC曲线分析显示模型的曲线下面积为0.945（95%置信区间：0.923～0.898），敏感度为85.90%，特异度为89.10%；Hosmer-Lemeshow拟合优度检验χ2=12.538，P=0.129。结论GH孕妇的血清PAF、Fibulin-3及脐动脉血流参数变化与新生儿结局有关，其中Fibulin-3升高是保护因素，血清PAF水平及脐动脉S/D、脐动脉PI、脐动脉RI降低是危险因素。本研究基于Fibulin-3、PAF、S/D、PI、RI构建的预测模型有较高应用价值及推广价值。 妊娠期高血压（gestational hypertension, GH）是常见妊娠并发症，随着肥胖、高龄等高危产妇的增加，GH的发病率也呈持续上升趋势[1]。GH发病机制复杂，涉及免疫学、遗传学、母体因素等多方面因素，其病理生理改变包括胎盘缺血缺氧、滋养细胞凋亡、血管内皮损伤、免疫不耐受等，严重危害母儿健康，还可能导致不良新生儿结局[2]。若能尽早识别不良新生儿结局的发生风险，则可及时予以干预，以尽可能改善新生儿结局。脐动脉是母胎之间的血循环通道及物质交换通道，脐动脉异常反映胎儿-胎盘血流循环异常，同时母胎物质交换也受到影响，而胎盘循环及物质交换直接影响胎儿的生长与健康，因此认为脐动脉血流变化可能与新生儿结局存在关联[3]。血小板活化因子（platelet-activating factor, PAF）即血小板膜糖蛋白中的蛋白质，不仅可促使血小板聚集，还可释放至细胞外发挥促凝作用，其水平变化可反映血液凝血情况[4]。GH发病过程中的氧化应激反应及血管内皮损伤可能加强凝血导致凝血系统失衡，而血液高凝会增加血管阻力，影响胎盘循环，危害胎儿健康，因此推测PAF可能与新生儿结局有关[5]。Fibulin-3是一种参与血管壁细胞外基质结构合成与稳定的分泌型糖蛋白，有研究发现GH患者的Fibulin-3水平低于正常水平，推测与病情加重及妊娠结局有关[6]。但PAF、Fibulin-3水平变化是否与新生儿结局有明显相关性还有待数据证实。基于此，本研究旨在揭示GH孕妇孕晚期PAF、Fibulin-3及脐动脉血流变化与新生儿结局的关系，以期为临床GH孕妇发生不良新生儿结局的早期预测提供新的参考。 资料与方法 一般资料 采用回顾性分析研究设计。收集2020年1月–2024年12月期间在我院进行规律产检及分娩的420例GH孕产妇的资料。纳入标准：①妊娠20周后确诊GH，孕妇自然安静状态下同一手臂≥2次测量的收缩压≥140 mmHg（1 mmHg=0.133 kPa）和（或）舒张压≥90 mmHg，尿蛋白检测阴性[7]；②单胎自然妊娠；③孕妇年龄为20～40岁；④妊娠期于我院进行规律的产检，且孕28周时均进行过产检；⑤临床资料齐全。排除标准：①孕妇合并肝、肾等脏器功能障碍性疾病；②孕前存在原发性高血压、糖尿病、恶性肿瘤等严重躯体疾病；③子痫前期、子痫，或伴发子痫前期；④孕妇存在精神类疾病。本研究经安徽医科大学第二附属医院伦理委员会批准（批号：K2024-批件-074）。 研究方法 资料收集 查阅孕产妇的电子档案，收集年龄、孕前体质量指数（body mass index, BMI）、分娩孕周、新生儿结局等资料。 PAF和Fibulin-3检测 孕28周，采集孕妇空腹静脉血3 mL，以3000 r/min速率离心10 min后取血清，采用酶联免疫吸附法检测PAF和Fibulin-3，试剂盒分别购自武汉赛培生物科技有限公司和北京百奥莱博科技有限公司。 超声检查 孕28周，使用飞利浦彩色多普勒超声仪（HD6型，荷兰飞利浦）及凸阵探头（C5-2型，频率1～5 MHz）行孕妇腹部超声检查。孕妇仰卧位，首先常规观察胎儿头围、双顶径等项目，再启动彩色多普勒血流成像模式观察脐动脉，在脐带胎盘端距胎盘附着点3 cm内探测脐动脉，取样容积为2 mm3，待流速曲线满意后冻结图像，采集至少3个连续、稳定的频谱图，测量脐动脉搏动指数（pulsatility index, PI）、收缩期峰速/舒张末期流速（peak systolic velocity/end diastolic veloci, S/D）、阻力指数（resistance index, RI），每个测量值均测量3次，结果取均值。 新生儿结局及分组 早产儿（分娩孕周达28周，但不足37周）、新生儿窒息（1 min Apgar评分≤7分）、低出生体质量儿（出生体质量<2500 pmc-13222912.title: An Update on Pain Management in Pediatric Spine Surgery
pmc-13222912.creator: Sara N Kiani, Katherine Bach, Vivian Kwok, Ishaan Swarup
pmc-13222912.description: Purpose of ReviewThis paper aims to provide an overview on current recommendations for perioperative pain control for pediatric spine surgery. Managing pediatric pain is important to decrease postoperative morbidity, improve early mobilization, and decrease narcotic analgesic use. We aimed to summarize the data on preoperative pain management, intraoperative pain management, and postoperative pain management pathways for pediatric spine surgery.

pmc-13474852.title: Magnitude of multidrug resistant Mycobacterium tuberculosis and associated risk factors among pulmonary tuberculosis patients in Tigray region, Ethiopia
pmc-13474852.creator: Guesh Fesaha Weldemariam, Medhanie Asmelash Mulaw, Tesfaye Sisay Tessema
pmc-13474852.description: BackgroundMultidrug resistant Mycobacterium tuberculosis (MDR-TB) is the main public health problem in resource constrained settings particularly in the Tigray region of Ethiopia, where diagnostic and treatment service are limited. Therefore, we aimed to examine post-war prevalence of MDR-TB in Tigray region.MethodsA cross-sectional study was conducted in Tigray Region between February 2024 and January 2025.

pmc-13507655.title: Head and Neck CT Lymphangiography in a Dog With Cutaneous Lymphangiosarcoma
pmc-13507655.creator: Jeanne Bleuet, Vincent Auffret, Edouard Martin, Marilène Paquet, Megan Murphy
pmc-13507655.description: A 9‐year‐old neutered male Australian Cattle Dog presented for severe, extensive, and progressive swelling of the neck and face. CT lymphangiography (CTL) of the head and neck demonstrated cervical lymphedema with imaging features of mid‐cervical lymphatic obstruction, regional lymphatic leakage, and local lymphadenopathy.

pmc-13633648.title: Engineering IL‐4 resistant proinflammatory human myeloid cells for cancer immunotherapy
pmc-13633648.creator: Theresa Barberi, Alan D. Friedman
pmc-13633648.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Adoptive transfer of proinflammatory myeloid cells enhances antitumor T‐cell responses and limits tumor growth in murine models. Previous work identified transcription factors NF‐κB p50 and STAT6 as key regulators whose inactivation enhances the inflammatory potential of murine myeloid cells. Herein, we translate murine findings to human cells and establish methods to generate proinflammatory myeloid cells from human marrow‐derived CD34+ hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs).
